result: FIX-ROUND CORRECTION: the original version of this receipt misread the '2.1.277'/'2.1.278' numbers in gap 8's text as additional ai-memory version citations. They are not. Cross-checked against catalogs/landscape/foundation.json (lines 110, 112, 131, 364, 726, etc., e.g. 'Claude Code 2.1.278 used Fable 5.1') and docs/grand-catalog-handbook.md (evidence/receipts/native-memory.json: 'native Claude 2.1.277 (claude-opus-5[1m])'), 2.1.277/2.1.278 are Claude Code CLIENT versions -- the version of the Claude Code session that made the cited memory_status/memory_read_page calls -- not ai-memory server/binary versions at all. That claim ('the catalog row's version citations are internally inconsistent across three different numbers') is retracted; it was a factual error in the original receipt, now corrected. Version currency, corrected: only ONE ai-memory version discrepancy is actually supported by this check -- gap 8's decision/pin text names ai-memory v2.3.1, while this check's fresh `ai-memory --version` on the installed binary returns 2.3.2. That single discrepancy (2.3.1 named vs. 2.3.2 installed) is real and stands; it is unrelated to, and should not be conflated with, the separate 2.1.277-vs-2.1.278 Claude Code client-version numbers in the same gap text, which describe two different native Claude Code sessions used across two different receipts, not ai-memory itself. Scope fields: on the CLI surface (write-page/search/delete-page/status), 2.3.2 resolves and PRINTS an explicit 'ai-memory: scope <workspace>/<project> (workspace + project from <path>/.ai-memory.toml)' line before every command's own output whenever a `.ai-memory.toml` marker is present in the caller's cwd (observed directly: running from $HOME/code/agent-lab resolved to agent-lab/agent-lab on every call, matching that project's own marker file). This shows the CLI's marker-based auto-detection working and explicit, which is consistent with (does not contradict) this project's own CLAUDE.md guidance for 'session-aware clients'. Auto-scope config default is [auto_scope] mode = per_actor (commented default, not overridden here) and [routing] mid_session = follow-cwd (also default), both read directly from config.toml comments rather than inferred. Auto-improve: config check performed first; no LLM provider was configured on the disposable instance (providers.llm: disabled) and no LLM credentials existed in the session environment, so the auto-improve trial was correctly SKIPPED rather than attempted -- this decision is recorded per the binding instruction, not silently omitted.
